definitions.usage: × away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter(-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew.
definitions.full: H5637. sarar סָרַר verb be stubborn, rebellious (usually towards ׳י ) (Late Hebrew id. , (rare); Assyrian sarâru ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ס יִשְׂרָאֵל Hosea 4:16 Israel is stubborn; Participle active וּמוֺרֶה סוֺרֵר בֵּן Deut 21:18 , compare 21:20 ; סוֺרְרִים בָּנִים Isa 30:1 , סוֺרֵר עַם 65:2 , ס ׳דּוֺר וּמֹרֶה Psa 78:8 (all of Israel); מ ׳לֵב וּמוֺרֶה Jer 5:23 ; סֹרֵרָ֔ה מָּרָה Hosea 4:16 (simile of Israel, see above); as predicate סוֺרְרִים שָׂרֵיהֶם 9:15 compare Isa 1:23 ; סוֺרְרִים סָרֵי Jer 6:28 revolters among the rebellious (? compare סור Qal near the end, and סַר below); of loose woman וְסוֺרָ֑רֶת הִיא הֹמִיָּסה Prov 7:11 ; as substantive = the stubborn , Psa 66:7 ; 68:7 ; 68:19 ; feminine singular סֹרֶ֫רֶת כָתֵף וַיִּתְּנוּ Neh 9:29 and they presented a stubborn shoulder (of Israel) = Zech 7:11 ( סֹרָ֑רֶת ).
